# World Changers Mental Health Care Organisation

> A non-profit transforming lives across Southern Africa through compassionate mental health care, counseling, education, and philanthropic action.

World Changers MHCO provides mental health support, runs community outreach and humanitarian campaigns, mobilises volunteers, and partners with donors to expand access to care. Based in Kenilworth, South Africa.
